project.name: Shortcast
project.description: macOS app that turns long videos into ready-to-post shorts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — fully on-device using on-device ML (Gemma 4, Qwen 3.5, WhisperKit)

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: CI/CD pipeline: on version tag, generates Xcode project, builds Release, packages .dmg, attaches to GitHub release

nodes.name: project.yml
nodes.summary: XcodeGen project definition: app target (Shortcast), probe tool, Swift SPM dependencies (Gemma4Swift, mlx-swift-lm, HuggingFace, WhisperKit)

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview: features, how it works (diagram), dependencies, setup, comparison to alternatives

nodes.name: NOTICE
nodes.summary: Legal notices and attribution for third-party dependencies

nodes.name: Info.plist
nodes.summary: macOS app bundle metadata: bundle ID, version, deployment target, category

nodes.name: social-content-coach.md
nodes.summary: Bundled prompt document: copywriter instructions for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube (tone, length, voice, quality bar)

nodes.name: ShortcastApp.swift
nodes.summary: App entry point: initializes environment (settings, modelManager, workspace), sets window properties

nodes.name: AppSettings.swift
nodes.summary: User configuration: API credentials, publishing settings, caption preferences; persisted to UserDefaults

nodes.name: VideoJob.swift
nodes.summary: Metadata for a dropped video (URL, duration); used throughout the processing pipeline

nodes.name: ClipCandidate.swift
nodes.summary: One viral moment picked by Director: start/end timestamps, rationale, hook text, overlay text

nodes.name: PostVariant.swift
nodes.summary: Platform-specific post (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) with hook, description, hashtags; also GenerationResult wrapper

nodes.name: PublishReport.swift
nodes.summary: Result of a publish operation: provider, platform outcomes, request ID

nodes.name: ShortClip.swift
nodes.summary: One generated short in progress: candidate + cut clip + editable captions + publish state; observable per-card

nodes.name: String+Trimmed.swift
nodes.summary: String utility extension: whitespace/newline trimming

nodes.name: ChatModelProfile.swift
nodes.summary: MLX model configuration: Qwen 3.5 9B and Gemma 4 12B sampling params, loader strategy

nodes.name: ModelManager.swift
nodes.summary: Model lifecycle management: download/load Gemma 4 E4B; manages Director (Qwen) loading

nodes.name: MomentFinderService.swift
nodes.summary: Director LLM service: transcribes long video context, finds viral moments, optional per-clip captions; includes MomentJSONParser

nodes.name: GemmaService.swift
nodes.summary: Multimodal generation orchestrator: extract audio, build prompt, run Gemma 4, parse result

nodes.name: MediaExtractor.swift
nodes.summary: Video I/O: validate, extract audio track, cut clips (passthrough or re-encode fallback)

nodes.name: PromptBuilder.swift
nodes.summary: Assembles full prompt: coach doc + language rules + style examples + JSON schema

nodes.name: JSONVariantParser.swift
nodes.summary: Tolerant JSON parser for model output: repairs drift, extracts balanced objects, maps to PostVariant

nodes.name: TranscriptionService.swift
nodes.summary: On-device Whisper transcription (lazy download); prefers .srt/.vtt sidecars; includes transcript slicing

nodes.name: VerticalReframer.swift
nodes.summary: Reframes 16:9 to 9:16 with on-device face tracking (Vision) + panning virtual camera; falls back to blurred letterbox

nodes.name: VideoOverlayRenderer.swift
nodes.summary: Burns text hook into clip (top band, fade out); re-encodes via AVVideoCompositionCoreAnimationTool

nodes.name: WorkspaceModel.swift
nodes.summary: Main state machine: two flows (single video caption vs. long video shorts); orchestrates the entire processing pipeline

nodes.name: PublishingProvider.swift
nodes.summary: Protocol + factory for publishing backends (Upload-Post, TikTok official); UploadPostProvider implementation

nodes.name: UploadPostClient.swift
nodes.summary: HTTP client for Upload-Post REST API: multipart form, all three platforms in one request

nodes.name: TikTokOfficialProvider.swift
nodes.summary: TikTok official API: inbox upload or direct post; handles video chunking and metadata

nodes.name: MimoService.swift
nodes.summary: Optional Xiaomi MiMo API client: remote LLM alternative to on-device models

nodes.name: KeychainStore.swift
nodes.summary: Minimal Keychain wrapper: read/write/delete generic passwords

nodes.name: ContentView.swift
nodes.summary: Root state machine view: gates on model readiness, routes through phases (empty, drop, processing, results)

nodes.name: DropZoneView.swift
nodes.summary: Idle screen: mode picker (caption short vs. make shorts), drag-and-drop target, file importer

nodes.name: ModelDownloadView.swift
nodes.summary: First-run model download screen: progress bar, memory warning, retry on fail

nodes.name: ProcessingView.swift
nodes.summary: Single-video flow: pulsing phone frame, analyzing progress message, video metadata

nodes.name: ResultsView.swift
nodes.summary: Single-video results: three editable platform cards in a scrollable row; Publish button + result sheet

nodes.name: PostPreviewCard.swift
nodes.summary: One platform's post preview: phone mockup with live video, platform chrome, editable text fields

nodes.name: PhoneVideoPlayer.swift
nodes.summary: NSViewRepresentable for silent looping video (no controls); used in previews and progress

nodes.name: ShortsProgressView.swift
nodes.summary: Long-video flow: cinematic scanner (16:9 frame with sweeping visual), filmstrip progress, headline/detail

nodes.name: ShortsResultsView.swift
nodes.summary: Long-video results: grid of short tiles (adaptive 190-240px), schedule button, publish all

nodes.name: ShortClipTile.swift
nodes.summary: Compact grid card per clip: phone preview, duration badge, approve toggle, play/edit/download actions

nodes.name: ShortClipCard.swift
nodes.summary: Full editor for one clip: moment rationale, cutting/captioning progress, reframe toggle, overlay text editor, platform previews, per-clip publish

nodes.name: PublishResultView.swift
nodes.summary: Modal: publish result (success/failure per platform, request ID)

nodes.name: ScheduleSheet.swift
nodes.summary: Modal: schedule approved clips (start date, interval days, plan preview, success view)

nodes.name: SettingsView.swift
nodes.summary: Configuration UI: Upload-Post, TikTok official, captions, MiMo, model status

nodes.name: Color+Hex.swift
nodes.summary: Hex color parser extension + platform tint color helper

nodes.name: probe main.swift
nodes.summary: Developer CLI tool: runs full generation pipeline headlessly (video -> audio -> Gemma -> JSON parse) without UI

nodes.name: Models
nodes.summary: Data model layer: pure structs and enums for video jobs, clips, posts, settings, and publishing reports

nodes.name: Services
nodes.summary: Business logic layer: ML inference, media processing, parsing, publishing, and state management

nodes.name: Views
nodes.summary: SwiftUI presentation layer: all macOS views for the two processing flows and settings

nodes.name: On-Device ML Inference
nodes.summary: Core architectural concept: all AI processing happens locally on the Mac using MLX, with Gemma 4 for multimodal captioning and Qwen 3.5 for transcript analysis

nodes.name: Two-Flow Pipeline
nodes.summary: The app supports two distinct processing flows: single-video captioning (drop short clip, get 3 platform posts) and long-video shorts (transcribe, find moments, cut, caption, reframe)

nodes.name: Multi-Platform Publishing
nodes.summary: Protocol-based publishing abstraction supporting Upload-Post (all 3 platforms) and TikTok Official API, with per-platform content normalization

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what Shortcast does: a macOS app that turns long videos into ready-to-post shorts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — fully on-device.

tour.title: App Entry Point
tour.description: ShortcastApp.swift bootstraps the macOS app, creating the three core environment objects (AppSettings, ModelManager, WorkspaceModel) and setting up the main window.

tour.title: Core State Machine
tour.description: WorkspaceModel is the heart of the app — an observable state machine managing two flows: single-video captioning and long-video shorts production. It orchestrates the entire pipeline from drop to publish.

tour.title: Data Models
tour.description: The data layer defines the vocabulary of the pipeline: VideoJob (input), ClipCandidate (viral moment), PostVariant (platform post), ShortClip (in-progress short), and PublishReport (result).

tour.title: On-Device ML Inference
tour.description: Three ML services power the intelligence: TranscriptionService (WhisperKit for speech-to-text), MomentFinderService (Qwen 3.5 Director for finding viral moments), and GemmaService (Gemma 4 E4B for multimodal captioning).

tour.title: Prompt Engineering
tour.description: PromptBuilder assembles the full AI prompt from the bundled social-content-coach.md (platform copywriting rules), language detection, style examples, and JSON schema. This drives both the Director and captioning models.

tour.title: Media Processing Pipeline
tour.description: MediaExtractor handles video validation, audio extraction, and clip cutting. VerticalReframer uses Vision-based face tracking to reframe 16:9 to 9:16. VideoOverlayRenderer burns text hooks into clips.

tour.title: Multi-Platform Publishing
tour.description: The PublishingProvider protocol abstracts two backends: UploadPostProvider (multipart form to Upload-Post API for all 3 platforms) and TikTokOfficialProvider (direct TikTok API with video chunking).

tour.title: SwiftUI Views — Navigation
tour.description: ContentView is the root navigator routing through phases: DropZoneView (idle), ModelDownloadView (first run), ProcessingView/ShortsProgressView (in flight), ResultsView/ShortsResultsView (done).

tour.title: SwiftUI Views — Results & Editing
tour.description: ResultsView shows three platform cards (PostPreviewCard). ShortsResultsView shows a grid of ShortClipTile cards. ShortClipCard provides full per-clip editing with reframe toggle, overlay text, and per-clip publishing.

tour.title: Settings & Configuration
tour.description: SettingsView provides the full configuration UI: API credentials (Upload-Post, TikTok), caption style preferences, MiMo remote LLM toggle, and model download status.

tour.title: Build & CI/CD
tour.description: project.yml defines the XcodeGen build (SPM dependencies: Gemma4Swift, mlx-swift-lm, WhisperKit). The GitHub Actions workflow automates release builds and .dmg packaging on version tags.

tour.title: Developer Tools
tour.description: Probe/main.swift is a CLI tool for headless pipeline testing — runs the full generation path (video → audio → Gemma → JSON parse) without the UI, useful for debugging and validation.
